title: Number of Air-conditioned Classrooms in Schools and Schools that are Most Vulnerable to Urban Heat Island Effect
what_it_is: Number of Air-conditioned Classrooms in Schools and Schools that are Most Vulnerable to Urban Heat Island Effect

sections.label: New school green design
sections.summary: New schools are designed for Green Mark Platinum Super Low Energy certification, emphasising passive design to reduce heat gain and air-conditioning reliance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All new schools are designed to achieve Green Mark Platinum Super Low Energy certification, which emphasises passive design to reduce heat gain, reduce reliance on air-conditioning and optimise natural ventilation.

sections.label: School cooling measures by 2027
sections.summary: By 2027 all schools get more powerful fans and cool paint, with air-conditioning considered for enclosed classrooms and studies on rising temperatures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: By 2027, all schools will be provided with additional and more powerful fans for classrooms as well as the coating of external building facades with cool paint.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We have also been working with schools to identify those that may experience pervasive heat build-up due to specific site constraints, conditions or surroundings that impede natural wind flow.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Air-conditioning can also be considered for classrooms that need to be enclosed for extended periods due to persistent dust or extreme noise, such as from nearby construction sites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE is working with other agencies and researchers to study the effects of rising temperatures on student learning and well-being, including gathering more data on local conditions and their effects.

sections.label: Targeting cooling measures at schools
sections.summary: A 2024 NUS study found cognitive performance declines above a temperature threshold, but cooling measures will be targeted at schools with more discomfort.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: Well, we did have a 2024 National University of Singapore study that identified that cognitive performance does decline above a certain temperature threshold.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: But this does not mean that all schools may need the same set of cooling measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We will continue to look across our schools and target the measures at the ones where students may be experiencing more discomfort and this may be temporary or permanent in nature.
